headline: When to Consider Replacing Your Water Softener
articleBody: It's easy to forget about your water softener until it stops doing its job. But how do you know when it's time for a replacement versus a simple repair? Usually, if your system is over 10-15 years old, it's likely nearing the end of its lifespan. You might start noticing that familiar hard water feel returning – think dry skin, spotty dishes, or crusty buildup around faucets. If your current softener constantly needs repairs, or if the repairs are becoming more expensive than the unit is worth, that's a huge red flag. Also, if your household's water usage has significantly changed, your old system might no longer be adequately sized. It's smart to have a professional from Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC take a look. We can assess your current system and help you understand if a replacement makes more sense in the long run, often saving you money and headaches.
